[quote=sal-baliz;60076199][b]Occupation of Sal-Baliz[/b]

THEP has officially begun its occupation of the Balizid territories. All territory previously held by the Sal-Baliz caliphate have been placed under the THEP occupational government of Baliz. This government is administered directly by the THEP security council, meaning all decisions will be made through a security council vote. This occupation will last for exactly one month, at which time THEP will announce the future of the territory and its people. 

During the occupation, units will be sent out to clear the final Sal-Baliz holdouts, to solidify THEP control over the territory. Additionally, tonnes of medical supplies, food, water and materials for infrastructure projects will be imported from Hydronia and other THEP members. The militaries of all THEP security council members will be allowed to enter and operate within the territory for the duration of the occupation.

The Sal-Balizs self-declared caliphate has been formally abolished. Additionally, borders of the balizid territories are in the process of being redrawn, both internal and external. This is to remove border gore, prevent ethnic & religious violence and facilitate easier trade with nearby countries.

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;60070217][b]Thýven: 2025[/b]

As the war between the Reich of the West and the powers of the East began to seemingly slowly wind down, the government of Thýven now turned its eyes to its powerful southern neighbor, a close ally, and frequent dealer in business, it had become apparent with the recent war, that isolationism would not be fully easy to come out of, and power was dependent on who you were allied with. However, Thýven for the longest time had not sought out to merely shake hands and pat backs, it had sought to unify nations under a common law, the law of the crown. 

But the government knew and Erjk Drs knew that performing such a unification was not feasible unless concessions were made to ensure sovereignty was still present for any party present. As such, the government of Thýven would send emissaries to the nation of Albany with a radical idea for unification, a political union of power and strength, led by a council of the heads of state of both Albany and Thýven, thereby creating a major power bloc in the East to counteract the aggressive West. 

[nation]Averne[/nation][/quote]
[b]Madness, Madness & Stupidity[/b]

Naturally that got the immediate reaction of a fart at a baby's funeral, as in it was laughed and immediately decried at the legislature in fiery speeches before they got to [i]actually[/i] debating it. Naturally, all the debate and back and forth got was an absurd and continuously expanding list of definitely not insane demands and requirements followed by a 'if the other two agree'. Who were the other two? Albany's sister nations. Their comrades. The greater commonwealth. The big three. The triple alliance. The triple cheese. The big

You get the picture.

The press milked it for all it was worth until there was not enough paper or databases to have it printed or posted on and the income lowered on the news topic of spontaneous unification proposals that definitely did not leak from the head of state's office, why, it should be impossible! It couldn't, officially, happen. Therefore it didn't happen. There is no leaks in the ship of government, especially from the atop. To say less is unpatriotic.

Of course it was then when people stopped waving their fists across the pond did they began to actually analyze the idea. The [i]official[/i] reply from Albany ended up being a big maybe depending on Hither & Averne. It was the nation's current national goal to unify all of the peninsula after all, why would they unify with a nation across the sea north of them without unifying themselves first? Thus negotiations would begin behind quiet and hushed talks.
